page_title: ROM 2-0 LAZ | AS Roma v Lazio 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' AS Roma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+2' Matias Soule (AS Roma) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Alessio Furlanetto pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
88' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Paulo Dybala and he is replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
86' It seemed like Pedro (Lazio) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) picks up a yellow card.
83' Substitution. Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) in, Gianluca Mancini out.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donyell Malen leaves the pitch and Matias Soule (AS Roma) comes on.
79' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) replaces Adam Marusic.
79' A substitution has been made. Tijjani Noslin goes off and Pedro (Lazio) comes on.
78' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).

76' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post.
74' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Matteo Cancellieri will be replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
70' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
70' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
66' 2 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Paulo Dybala and Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top of the net. The score is 2:0.
66' There's an opportunity for Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

65' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Alessio Furlanetto to dive and make a save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
64' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Nuno Tavares (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
63' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.
63' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but Alessio Furlanetto punches the ball away.
62' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Kenneth Taylor is replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
62' Substitution. Boulaye Dia did his best and is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Lazio).
61' A long through ball into the box almost gives Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
58' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
56' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is able to continue to play.
55' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is about to take a corner kick.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
53' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
52' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call.

49' Great solo effort by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar is alert and denies him.
48' CHANCE! Nuno Tavares (Lazio) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
47' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a half-time substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) comes on in place of Niccolo Pisilli.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is flagged for offside.
45+4' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+1' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
42' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
40' 1 - 0 Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
39' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) will take the corner.
39' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
37' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make a change. Evan Ndicka is unable to continue due to injury, Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) comes on.
35' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
34' Close! Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
33' Mario Gila (Lazio) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
33' Corner kick. Toma Basic (Lazio) is ready to send the ball into the box.
32' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
30' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has a goal ruled out for offside!
28' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
27' The ball is cleared after Donyell Malen (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

21' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Fabio Maresca blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
19' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
18' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alessio Furlanetto comes off the line to clear the ball away.
16' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
15' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul after Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) hacks down one of his opponents.
13' Wonderful movement by AS Roma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
12' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

11' A rebound falls to Wesley Franca (AS Roma) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Alessio Furlanetto anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
10' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
9' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
9' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared. AS Roma win a corner.
7' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
7' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
5' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
4' The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
2' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca is introduced as the referee for today's match.
